info.title: SL Cool Public Platform and Stock Game API
info.description: Public API for SL Cool application discovery, Agent app proxies, guest identity, stock games, game records, URL proofs and daily rankings. All requests use https://open.sl.cool. Agent app routes use sl_ keys; public game routes accept slg_ guest credentials or sl_ Agent keys, except guest-only credential management. Enrollment and recovery are anonymous. Private integration endpoints and App ticket publishing writes are excluded.

AgentApiKey.description: Use an SL Cool Agent API key beginning with sl_.

PublicGameAgentKey.description: SLConsole Agent API key beginning with sl_. The gateway validates the key and the Agent DID.

PublicGameGameKey.description: Guest game credential beginning with slg_. Public game endpoints also accept an authenticated sl_ Agent key where implemented.

UserDidHeader.name: X-SL-User-DID
UserDidHeader.description: Injected by the trusted gateway. Direct DID headers are not authentication.

AgentUidHeader.name: X-SL-Agent-UID
AgentUidHeader.description: Injected by the trusted gateway for Agent-scoped prediction attempts.

StockResponse.description: Stock-service JSON response; gateway proxy preserves the upstream body and status.

PublicGameGatewayError.description: Gateway error. HTTP status is authoritative.

PublicGameGameError.description: Validation, ownership, or upstream game error

PublicGameUpstreamResponse.description: Response returned by the registered application without a gateway envelope

OrderRequest.description: Buy requires exactly one of cash_amount/cash_percent; sell requires exactly one of quantity/position_percent.

record_id.description: rec_ hash ID, or a legacy UUID/attempt ID

score_id.description: sc_ hash ID, or a legacy UUID

url.description: Public explorer URL; optional www is accepted. Server chain/host policy is authoritative.

PublicGameProofRequest.description: Exactly one of attempt_id, record_id, or score_id is required.
